completedSessions.summary: Created the Android/Compose foundation, product documentation, and polished browser shell.
Implemented lifecycle-safe single-tab WebView browsing with secure defaults, URL/search parsing, navigation, progress, title, errors, back dispatch, and state restoration.
Implemented callback-only original HTML, rendered DOM, and visible-text extraction with on-device viewers, clipboard abstraction, accessible copy feedback, and local WebView fixture coverage.
Implemented bounded per-tab JavaScript console capture with level, source, line, timestamp seams, level and errors-only filters, local copy/clear/export actions, and a floating entry button.

Implemented immersive system-bar and app-chrome hiding with an always-available accessible exit control, seven persisted position modes including normalized free drag, and size, opacity, and auto-hide controls.

Implemented on-device URL, title, link, image URL, Markdown, and selected-HTML extraction plus long-press element inspection with a visible selection overlay, tag/id/class/selector details, and validated selector re-query behavior.

Implemented active-page title, URL, SSL, load-time, viewport, metadata, Open Graph, favicon, cookies, localStorage, and sessionStorage inspection with local copy and confirmed origin-scoped clear actions.

Implemented a bounded per-tab observable request log with method, reported HTTP error status, local block status, explicit WebView visibility limits, and reload-applied per-tab JavaScript, ad-blocking, image, and validated Mobile/Desktop/Custom user-agent controls.

Implemented bounded tab create/switch/close with one live WebView, per-tab saved state and logs, explicit incognito boundary clearing and no-history policy, and native find-in-page controls with match feedback.

Implemented graceful focused reader extraction, reversible per-tab page dark transforms, bounded full-page PNG capture, and user-selected Storage Access Framework exports for original HTML, rendered HTML, and visible text.

Implemented bounded on-device history and bookmarks with strict incognito gating, cancellable DownloadManager handoff, Android text sharing, and a permission-rationalized CameraX/ML Kit QR URL scanner with invalid-input handling.

Implemented the complete typed developer settings catalog with grouped Material UI, theme-aware Light/Dark/AMOLED palettes, per-setting effects (search engine, DNT, screen-on, defaults, preferred plain/Markdown copy for links and images, console policy, CSS/JS injection), schema-validated import/export, a usable saved user-agent list, a download-folder picker used as the SAF export start location with documented DownloadManager limits, and activity-finish-only clear-on-exit.
